verdict.rationale: Figma provides an official REST API with OpenAPI spec and TypeScript types (figma-docs-46), a Plugin/Widget API (figma-docs-8, figma-docs-32), Code Connect SDK/CLI on GitHub (figma-gh-1, figma-gh-2, figma-docs-60), and an official MCP server for AI-native workflows (figma-probe-3, figma-docs-1). These are well-documented, first-party SDKs/APIs explicitly built for programmatic and AI-agent integration. missing for 10: no independent hands-on developer corroboration of SDK reliability/completeness, and probe found no discoverable openapi.json at the expected well-known endpoints despite a spec repo existing.
